newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan lead battery sales rise 9.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan lead battery sales rise 9.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's sales of domestic lead batteries, measured in volume of contained lead, rose 9.6 percent in January from the same period the year before to 21,563 tonnes, the Japan Storage Battery Association said on Friday.
Contained lead in Japanese battery sales in January was (in tonnes):
(NOTE: Automotive includes a small quantity of lead used in two-wheeled vehicles. Industrial use includes stationary power sources and electric vehicles such as forklifts.)
Unit shipments of Japanese car batteries also rose in January, as a sharp rise in shipments for new cars more than offset a slump in replacement battery shipments.
(NOTE: Unit shipment data excludes two-wheeled vehicles.)
